commands:
BASE=$(.prflow/vendor/prflow/scripts/config-get.sh .base_branch main) || BASE=""
[ -n "$BASE" ] || BASE=main
CUR=$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null) || CUR=""
echo "BASE=$BASE CUR=$CUR"
COMMON_DIR=$(git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir 2>/dev/null) || COMMON_DIR=""
GIT_DIR_PATH=$(git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-dir 2>/dev/null) || GIT_DIR_PATH=""
echo "COMMON_DIR=$COMMON_DIR GIT_DIR_PATH=$GIT_DIR_PATH"

chmod +x /home/runner/work/prflow/prflow/scripts/telemetry-master-off.py
cd /home/runner/work/prflow/prflow
d=.prflow/tmp/tm-fix; mkdir -p "$d"
printf '{"telemetry":{"enabled":false}}\n' > "$d/bool-false.json"
printf '{"telemetry":{"enabled":true}}\n'  > "$d/bool-true.json"
printf '{"telemetry":{"enabled":"false"}}\n' > "$d/str-false.json"
printf '{"telemetry":{"enabled":0}}\n' > "$d/num-0.json"
printf '{"telemetry":{"enabled":null}}\n' > "$d/null.json"
printf '{"telemetry":[]}\n' > "$d/arr.json …[per-command-truncated]

for k in prflow_review_and_fix.efficiency_telemetry_enabled prflow.execution_diagnostics_enabled prflow.execution_denial_commands_enabled prflow_review.live_progress_comment_enabled create_issue.investigation_record_enabled base_branch; do printf '%s => ' "$k"; scripts/config-get.sh "$k" true .prflow/tmp/cfg-master-off.json; done
git merge-base origin/main HEAD && echo "---FILES---" && git diff --name-status $(git merge-base origin/main HEAD) HEAD && echo "---STAT---" && git diff --stat $(git merge-base origin/main HEAD) HEAD

cd /home/runner/work/prflow/prflow; mkdir -p .prflow/tmp/review/pr-2041/33036020051-1; git diff 1d4e7c30c1efd18b1e358713775055fe6b814820 HEAD > .prflow/tmp/review/pr-2041/33036020051-1/diff.patch; wc -l .prflow/tmp/review/pr-2041/33036020051-1/diff.patch

scrub.shapes: GitHub tokens/PATs, Anthropic keys, Bearer Authorization headers, and basic Authorization headers
